norm: the signaling initiates configured follow up actions for shutdown in the bswm
assumption: The signaling initiates configured follow-up actions for shutdown in the BswM.
rationale: The specification only mentions the signaling of the shutdown by the ComM, but does not specify internal follow-up sequences of the BswM.

original.text: Annahme: Die Signalisierung stößt im BswM konfigurierte Folgeaktionen zur Abschaltung an — trifft das zu?
